name: 协议提案 / Protocol proposal

title: '[Proposal] '
labels: ''

---

### 待解决的问题 / Problem

当前规范哪条规则无法表达什么需求？提供不依赖具体平台的场景和反例。
Which rule fails to express which need? Provide platform-independent scenarios and counterexamples.

### 建议与替代 / Proposal and alternatives

给出字段/语义前后差异，解释为何属于核心或可选扩展；至少列出不改规范的替代方案。
Show field/semantic changes, explain core versus extension placement and include a no-change alternative.

### 原则与影响 / Principles and impact

需求与交易分离、角色中立、隐私、来源声明、去中心和免费协议是否受影响？
Effects on independent need/transaction states, role neutrality, privacy, provenance, decentralization and free protocol use:

### 兼容性与验证 / Compatibility and validation

旧生产者/消费者的行为、版本标识、迁移策略、正反测试、独立实现证据或缺口：
Old producer/consumer behavior, versioning, migration, positive/negative tests and independent implementation evidence or gaps:

### 开放问题 / Open questions

尚不能决定的取舍、反对意见、需要的证据：
Unresolved tradeoffs, objections and evidence needed:

重大变更请附 docs/rfcs/0000-template.md 格式 RFC；Issue、投票与表情不自动修改规范。
For major changes, attach an RFC using the template. Issues, votes and reactions do not amend the specification automatically.
